blockers.message: Codex nested workspace-write sandbox failed inside the outer sandbox with sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted (exit 71), so every read, command, and patch tool was unavailable.
Codex injected globally installed skill descriptions even though the frozen profile used ignore-user-config, ignore-rules, empty skills, empty MCPs, empty plugins, and strict config.

unsafe_fallback_not_run: Disabling Codex's inner sandbox while using the compatibility outer profile would grant agent tools ambient host write access outside enumerated denied roots.
minimum_resource_to_resume: One disposable macOS or Linux worker/VM with a disposable Codex credential and no global skills/plugins, where the worker boundary replaces nested local sandboxing.
